dz: 德国国王奥托三世在教宗约翰十五世去世后,选择卡林西亚的堂兄布鲁诺为教皇. 布鲁诺以格里高利五世的名字成为教皇.
de: German king Otto III chooses his cousin Bruno of Carinthia as pope following the death of Pope John XV. Bruno becomes pope under the name Gregory V.

t: 16岁的奥托三世被加冕为神圣罗马皇帝.
te: Sixteen-year-old Otto III is crowned Holy Roman Emperor.
dz: 16岁的奥托三世被加冕为神圣罗马皇帝.
de: Sixteen-year-old Otto III is crowned Holy Roman Emperor.

de: Al-Hakim bi-Amr Allah becomes caliph. He is the first Fatimid ruler to have been born in Egypt and arguably the most controversial member of the dynasty.

de: Emperor Otto III issues a deed to Gottschalk, Bishop of Freising, which is the oldest known document using the name Ostarrîchi (Austria in Old High German).
